summary_brief: 今日呈现三大技术趋势：AI 工具链安全强化（gh.sh 包装器模式在多个仓库落地）、超长上下文代码模型（GPT-5.3-Codex 40万上下文）被主流工具采纳、多 Agent 工作流进入工程化成熟期（v1.0 正式发布）。同时，MCP 生态集成标准化、流式响应优化、测试基础设施从 Mock 向真实集成环境迁移也是值得关注的演进方向。

engineering_signals.title: CLI 安全包装器模式跨项目落地
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gh.sh 白名单包装器模式同时在 Claude Agent SDK、Claude Code、Claude Code Action 三个仓库落地，建立了 CI/CD 自动化工作流的安全边界。这种「最小权限暴露」设计为 CLI 工具集成提供了可复制的安全范式，尤其对 Issue Triage 等高风险自动化场景至关重要。

engineering_signals.title: 超长上下文代码模型（GPT-5.3-Codex）工具链全面集成
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: GPT-5.3-Codex 模型（40 万上下文）同日被 Zed 编辑器、OpenCode、Cline 等主流工具集成，标志着新一代超长上下文能力已成为 AI 编程工具的标准配置。Zed 还同步引入 `ToolInput` 结构体支持增量流式输入，为低延迟实时工具调用打下基础。

engineering_signals.title: AI 辅助开发工作流进入 v1.0 成熟阶段
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Code GitHub Action 发布 v1.0 正式版，统一交互与自动化模式并支持所有 CLI 功能，标志着 AI 辅助开发工作流已从实验阶段进入生产可用阶段。同期 Zed 支持多种 Agent 会话历史持久化，OpenAI Codex 引入 CSV 驱动的并行任务分发与可视化进度追踪，多 Agent 协作的可观测性和易用性大幅提升。

engineering_signals.title: MCP 生态集成标准化与 SDK 封装
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Anthropic SDK 引入 MCP 工具、提示词和资源的标准化转换辅助函数，降低多模态上下文集成的复杂度。Gemini CLI 同步推出 SDK 封装并转向策略引擎权限管理，CLI 工具链正从单一命令执行向可编程、可扩展的 SDK 生态演进。

engineering_signals.title: 流式响应与实时反馈体验优化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Agno 修复 Slack 接口 10-25 秒空白延迟，实现带实时进度卡的流式响应；Zed 引入流式工具输入支持。这反映了 AI 工具正从「请求-等待-响应」模式向低延迟实时反馈演进，尤其对企业协作场景（Slack 集成）和长文本生成场景（代码补全）的用户体验提升显著。

engineering_signals.title: AI 基础设施从 Mock 测试向真实集成环境迁移
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Dify 将大量 SQL 测试迁移至 Testcontainers，gptme 为多模态管道（图片自动附加）添加端到端测试和调试日志。这种从 Mock 向真实集成环境的转向，反映了 AI 基础设施项目对数据层可靠性和复杂功能（如多模态）端到端验证的重视。

engineering_signals.title: AI Agent 系统多层安全加固
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 强制执行沙箱信封防止 Zsh fork 逃逸，OpenHands 修复两个 CVE 漏洞（protobuf、pypdf），gptme 移除工具示例中的 System 消息以防止模型幻觉，LangGraph 文档化默认拒绝认证模式。AI Agent 系统正在从多层防御边界（沙箱、依赖、提示工程、认证）全面提升安全性。

engineering_signals.title: 异步运行时与并发控制修复
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: LlamaIndex 修复 `run_async_tasks` 阻塞问题改用 `asyncio.gather`，解决潜在死锁；Deer-flow 将子代理超时配置化。这些修复反映了高并发 AI 应用对异步运行时稳定性和可控性的精细化需求，是多 Agent 系统工程化落地的基础保障。

release_signals.title: Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0 正式发布
release_signals.why_it_matters: GitHub Action v1.0 重大更新，统一了交互与自动化模式，简化配置并支持所有 CLI 功能，标志着 AI 辅助开发工作流进入成熟可用阶段。

release_signals.title: OpenCode v1.2.11 引入实验性工作区服务
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 `workspace-serve` 命令和会话列表 API，增强了 AI 编程工具对开发环境的控制能力和会话管理能力。

release_signals.title: Zed v0.225.9 深度集成外部 Agent 会话历史
release_signals.why_it_matters: Zed 编辑器现已支持 Auggie、Claude、Codex 等多种外部 Agent 的会话历史持久化与面板恢复，实现了编辑器与 AI Agent 的深度双向集成。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Codex v0.105.0 增强多 Agent 工作流
release_signals.why_it_matters: 引入 CSV 驱动的 Agent 并行任务分发、子 Agent 昵称管理及可视化进度追踪，显著提升了多 Agent 协作模式的可观测性和易用性。

release_signals.title: Gemini CLI v0.30.0 引入 SDK 与策略引擎
release_signals.why_it_matters: 正式引入 SDK 封装并废弃旧版工具限制，转向基于策略引擎的权限管理，大幅提升了 CLI 的可扩展性和安全性控制粒度。

release_signals.title: Cline v3.67.1 发布 SDK 与 Codex 5.3 支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: 推出 Cline SDK API 实现可编程访问，并支持最新的 Codex 5.3 模型，增强了工具的集成能力和模型兼容性。

releases.summary:
# 🎉 Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0 - Now Generally Available!

We're excited to announce the v1.0 release of Claude Code GitHub Action! This major release brings significant improvements in simplicity, flexibility, and power to AI-assisted development workflows.

## 🚀 What's New in v1.0

### Simplified Configuration
- **Automatic mode detection** - No more manual `mode` configuration. The action intelligently determines whether to run in interactive or automation mode based on your setup
- **Unified interface** - All prompts now go through a single `prompt` input, and all CLI options through `claude_args`
- **Better SDK alignment** - Closer integration with the Claude Code CLI for a consistent experience

### More Powerful & Flexible
- Direct access to all Claude Code CLI capabilities through `claude_args`
- Support for custom system prompts, tool configurations, and model selection
- Enhanced compatibility with AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

This release includes breaking changes from v0.x. Key deprecated inputs have been replaced with a cleaner, more intuitive API:
- `mode`, `direct_prompt`, `override_prompt` → unified `prompt` input
- `custom_instructions`, `model`, `allowed_tools`, `mcp_config` → `claude_args` with CLI format
- Other deprecated: `disallowed_tools`, `anthropic_model`, `trigger_phrase`, `timeout_minutes`

**📚 Please review our [Migration Guide](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/migration-guide.md) for detailed upgrade instructions and examples.**

## 💡 New Use Cases & Examples

Explore the expanded possibilities with v1.0! We've created comprehensive examples showcasing various workflows:

- **Automated PR Reviews** - Intelligent code review on every pull request
- **CI Failure Fixes** - Automatically diagnose and fix failing tests
- **Issue Triage** - Smart categorization and response to new issues
- **Documentation Generation** - Keep docs in sync with code changes
- **Security Scanning** - Proactive vulnerability detection
- **And many more!**

**🔧 Check out all examples at [github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples)**

## 🏃 Quick Start

```yaml
# Interactive mode - responds to @claude mentions
- uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
  with:
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

# Automation mode - runs immediately with prompt
- uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
  with:
    prompt: "Review this PR for security issues"
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
    claude_args: |
      --model claude-4-0-sonnet-20250805
      --max-turns 10
```

## 📖 Resources

- [Migration Guide](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/migration-guide.md) - Step-by-step upgrade instructions
- [Examples](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples) - Ready-to-use workflow templates

## 🙏 Thank You

- Multi-agent workflows are easier to run and track: `spawn_agents_on_csv` can fan out work from a CSV with built-in progress/ETA, and sub-agents are easier to follow with nicknames, a cleaner picker, and visible child-thread approval prompts. (#10935, #12320, #12327, #12332, #12570, #12767)
- The TUI picked up new convenience commands: `/copy` copies the latest complete assistant reply, while `/clear` and `Ctrl-L` clear the screen without losing thread context, with `/clear` also able to start a fresh chat. (#12444, #12520, #12613, #12628)
- Approval controls are more flexible: Codex can now ask for extra sandbox permissions for a command, and you can auto-reject specific approval prompt types without turning approvals off entirely. (#11871, #12087)
- App-server clients can do more with threads: `thread/list` can search by title, thread status is exposed in read/list responses and notifications, and `thread/resume` returns the latest turn inline so reconnects are less lossy. (#11776, #11786, #12578)

## Bug Fixes
- Long links in the TUI stay clickable when wrapped, which also fixes related clipping and layout issues in several views. (#12067)
- Several TUI interaction edge cases were fixed: queued-message editing now works in more terminals, follow-up prompts no longer get stuck if you press Enter while a final answer is still streaming, and approval dialogs now respond with the correct request id. (#12240, #12569, #12746)
- `@` parsing in the chat composer is more reliable, so commands like `npx -y @scope/pkg@latest` no longer accidentally open the file picker or block submission. (#12643)
- App-server websocket handling is more robust: thread listeners survive disconnects, Ctrl-C waits for in-flight turns before restarting, and websocket clients that send `permessage-deflate` can connect successfully. (#12373, #12517, #12629)
- Linux sandboxed commands now get a minimal `/dev`, fixing failures in tools that need entropy or other standard device nodes. (#12081)
- `js_repl` now reports uncaught kernel failures more clearly, recovers cleanly afterward, and correctly attaches `view_image` results from nested tool calls. (#12636, #12725)

## Documentation
- Added a public security policy with Bugcrowd reporting guidance. (#12193)
- Updated install and local workflow docs to use `cargo install --locked cargo-nextest` and to avoid routine `--all-features` builds unless you specifically need full feature coverage. (#12377, #12429)

This week's release includes session history for external agents, agent panel restoration (so your threads survive editor restarts), thinking effort level controls for supported models, mermaid diagram support in markdown preview, and the option to include LSP document symbols in breadcrumbs and outline UI (`"document_symbols": "on"`).

Additionally, Linux now uses `wgpu` as the graphics backend, resolving a handful of outstanding stability issues.

## Features

### AI

- ACP: Exposed session history for the following external agents: Auggie, Claude Agent, Codex, Factory Droid, Junie, Kimi CLI, Mistral Vibe, and OpenCode. ([#49449](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49449))
- Agent: Added support for controlling thinking effort levels with supported models using the Zed provider. ([#49274](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49274))
- Agent: Added support for installing ACP agents via ACP registry in remote projects. ([#48935](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/48935))
- Agent: Added agent panel restoration. Now restarting your editor won't cause your thread to be forgotten. ([#48800](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/48800))
- Agent: Changed "Always allow" suggestions for terminal commands to be subcommand-specific (e.g. "Always allow for `cargo build` commands" instead of "Always allow for `cargo` commands"). ([#49148](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49148))
- Agent: Added `allow_extended_context` to the Bedrock settings which enables 1M context windows on models that support it. ([#48542](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/48542); thanks [5herlocked](https://github.com/5herlocked))

ai_summary.summary_cn: v1.2.11 版本主要聚焦于 Windows 平台的全面支持改进，修复了大量跨平台兼容性问题并优化了路径处理逻辑。同时新增了 workspace-serve 实验性命令、会话列表 API 以及桌面版独立发布流程，并修复了 TUI 黑屏、终端问题等多个关键 Bug。

top_pain_points.topic: Model access failures from API providers
top_pain_points.review_reason: 高频(11个issue)主流程阻断问题。用户请求模型时遇到404模型不存在、配额用尽、TLS连接失败等各类错误，完全无法获得模型响应。证据包括：10832/10815的Groq 404错误、10827/10818/10810的OpenAI配额超限、10829的网络TLS握手失败、10825的Remote-SSH模型发现失败。这是用户使用Continue的核心流程，高频阻断直接影响产品可用性。

top_pain_points.topic: Model provider compatibility issues - structured outputs, function calling, and message handling failures
top_pain_points.review_reason: 高频且阻断主流程：5个issues报告实际bug导致功能不可用（7201:DeepSeek结构化输出返回400错误、7115:Anthropic多agent消息分割导致下游接收空输入、7132:OpenRouter无法function call、5621:Gemini返回None导致程序崩溃、7136:Gemini function call返回400错误），直接影响多agent workflow执行、结构化输出和function calling核心功能。虽仅单仓但count≥5且均有明确的运行时阻断证据。
所有5个issues都明确显示workflow在启动阶段立即崩溃，在API调用前就失败（'$0 cost', 'before any API calls', 'crashes immediately'）。这是主流程完全阻断问题，高频(count=5)且无法通过workaround绕过，直接影响用户CI/CD核心功能。

top_pain_points.topic: Configuration options being silently ignored or misapplied
top_pain_points.review_reason: 配置被静默忽略导致明确的功能阻断：#4080中historyDbPath被忽略导致进程崩溃（SQLITE_CANTOPEN），#4040和#4057中URL/baseURL配置被忽略导致无法连接到自定义embedding服务，#3692中构建变量未设置导致部署失败。这些都是主流程阻断问题，用户无法正常使用mem0的核心功能。

top_pain_points.topic: LLM response parsing/format issues causing memory and embedding operations to fail
top_pain_points.review_reason: LLM响应解析问题导致核心记忆功能完全失败：#4061和#4108中JSON解析失败导致无法添加记忆（返回空结果），#4081中LLM输出对象格式导致Ollama崩溃（cannot unmarshal object），#4099中产生幻觉记忆创建虚假数据，#4054中Invalid JSON导致embedding失败。这些都是主流程阻断，影响memory.add()和memory.search()等核心API。
